subject: Renewal: scale commit & term roadmap for Q3 expansion
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@apexretail.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: todd.simms@apexretail.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 usage spike — renewal conversation

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the quick run-through last week. We dug into the raw logs and confirmed a sustained increase in embed + gen traffic after our promotional rollout (mid-Feb). Given that trend, the finance team wants to lock a committed floor before Q3 planning.

Two asks from our side to move forward:
1) A detailed cost impact matrix for a stepped commit (250M -> 500M -> 1B tokens) with the proposed term lengths and volume discounts.
2) Confirmation on latency SLO when we enable the higher-concurrency pool (we saw tail latency spikes in a couple of sessions).

Can you loop in the ops/engineering leads who can validate latency SLOs and a concrete timeline for capacity provisioning? We need a decision by April 8 to include in our forecast.

Cheers,
Elena
VP, Product Engineering
Apex Retail

Attachment: apex_q1_usage_breakdown.csv (text/csv, 124KB)

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@apexretail.com>, Todd Simms <todd.simms@apexretail.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 usage spike — renewal conversation

Elena, Todd —

Appreciate the heads-up and for attaching the usage CSV. I ran the numbers with Ben and Marcus and we put together a preliminary commit/term matrix and a short notes doc on latency behavior with burst pools. See the attached proposal. High level:

- If you commit to 500M tokens over 12 months (staged: 150M for Q3, 175M Q4, remainder H2), the blended per-token rate drops ~18% vs current run-rate and we can reserve dedicated burst capacity during peak promos.
- 1B token commitment over 18 months moves an additional ~10% off that price and includes a two-week guaranteed warm-up window for your dedicated pool to avoid tail spikes.
- For immediate concerns we can enable prefix caching and a KV cache policy which reduces gen token generation by ~12% for your current patterns (Ben validated with a representative prompt set).

Latency SLO: Marcus validated 99th percentile tail at 420ms for the dedicated burst pool in our staging runs (95th at ~120ms). We will instrument the exact workloads in a short smoke test before any scale-out.

Next steps I propose:
1) We share the attached proposal with your finance and infra leads.
2) Ben does a 48-hour smoke test against a cloned subset of your production prompt set (we can start Wed).
3) If the smoke test looks good, we issue a redlined amendment for a 12-month 500M commit and a two-week scheduled warm-up window.

Can you confirm availability for the smoke test and whether finance prefers a monthly or quarterly invoicing cadence for the commit?

Thanks — looping Ben, Marcus, Monica for ops/finance specifics.

Best,
Aisha
Account Exec, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 14:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 usage spike — renewal conversation

Elena/Todd —

Quick operational note from the smoke-test plan:
- Test window: Thu 2027-04-01 22:00 UTC -> Fri 2027-04-02 22:00 UTC (48 hours).
- Test scope: 5M gen tokens simulated with representative concurrency (peak 70 rps sustained bursts).
- Metrics we'll collect: P50/P95/P99 latency, error rate, queue depth, KV cache hit ratio, and token cost per request.

Preliminary attachments include a short runbook for the test and expected dashboards. If Elena confirms we can use your staging API key (or we can run against a masked copy). We will notify 30min before ramp.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks team —

Confirming: we can run the smoke test starting Thu 22:00 UTC. Finance prefers quarterly invoicing for the committed floor. Two quick clarifications before we kick:
1) For the 12-month 500M option, can you confirm the ramp credit schedule (how many free burst credits during the warm-up)?
2) If tail latency remains above 500ms at P99 during the test, what is the rollback/fallback plan?

If those are straightforward we'll proceed and expect the redline after the test.

Best,
Elena
VP, Product Engineering
Apex Retail
